look: chibi young ruler of Qi in the Spring and Autumn period: round face, thick eyebrows, small goatee, hair in a topknot under a small black lacquered crown-cap (guan) with a gold band and a jade hairpin, tied with a cord under the chin, no bead curtains, crimson cross-collared robe closing right-over-left with gold-embroidered borders, jade pendant at the belt. Pre-imperial Zhou dynasty clothing
